description.value:
You force sorrow upon your target, and their eyes well with water, impairing their vision and making them weep uncontrollably. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dazzled] until they Interact to clear their vision.

Failure The target is dazzled and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1}, and one ongoing emotion effect on them of your choice that has a lower counteract rank than this spell is suppressed for the spell's duration.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target can't speak for as long as they are stupefied.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
